messages:
jamie_support: Escalating — AcmeCo onboarding stalled; payment gateway integration failing in UAT and trial expires tomorrow. Need CSM handoff.

maria_cs: On it. Can you summarize steps tried + ENG ticket ETA?

jamie_support: Rekeyed webhook, rotated API creds, error 502 from our adapter only in customer's VPC. ENG ticket ENG-8791 opened, eng estimates ~4h. Customer asking for go-live timeline.

oliver_csm: Renew risk high. Recommend: 1) immediate CSM intro call 2) temporary sandbox creds to finish onboarding 3) expedited provisioning on intent to buy.

sasha_enablement: I can run enablement at 09:30 PT. Need a concise checklist for the sandbox flow.

kyle_se: Sandbox checklist:
```
1) swap creds in app settings
2) run smoke: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/activate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_TOKEN>' -d '{"org":"ACME"}'
3) expect 200 + activation_id in response
4) confirm tokens in Console > Integrations
```

jamie_support: Customer contact is tina@acme.co — told them we're investigating and offered sandbox. Tina prefers a quick call.

maria_cs: Plan: I'll do intro + risk review at 11:00 PT. Oliver, please draft renewal outreach; Sasha, share enablement checklist by 10:00.

oliver_csm: Drafting now. Exec note: offer credits or SLA waiver while we debug; will post draft here.

cs-bot: Reminder: Trial for ACME-438 expires in ~20h. Auto-renew disabled.

jamie_support: I'll update ENG-8791 with this comms plan and loop eng when CSM confirms call. @maria_cs handing off.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: sending invite to Tina. Keep updates flowing here.
